value.rationale: The motivating primary source explicitly lacked an arbitrary-size proof and relied on finite determinant/eigenvalue computations. An exact all-order product factors the spectral gaps and converts global matrix positivity into one diagonal sign test on each interval. It explains and proves every-size isolation of the first K-1 eigenvalues, a substantive operator-bootstrap classification rather than a routine small numerical check. Scope is carefully limited to the no-flux Legendre operator and original alternative ordering; no downstream general theorem or independent validation is claimed.
